transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reported by Moomoo: Anthropic's Investor Day is examining whether new revenue data can help revive the artificial intelligence sector.
Cognitum One has released Ruflo, an agent orchestration tool for Claude Code and Codex. Reported by Voice of Alexandria: Ruflo enables end-to-end artificial intelligence agent workflows with human approval and enterprise-grade security.
Still open, per News 9: Anthropic warns that artificial intelligence worms could spread in smart homes within months and may soon self-replicate and infect smart devices.
Reported by FindArticles: California has enacted a law requiring clinicians to retain judgment over artificial intelligence in patient care, effective January 1, 2027.
Nvidia's artificial intelligence chip share drops to 34 percent in China amid rising domestic competition. Reported by 디지털투데이: Nvidia's China artificial intelligence chip shipments fall 44 percent as Huawei's share jumps.
